    The modules V_X̃ over finite subcategories of L #

    Lemma 4.8 and the first step of Lemma 4.13. L is the graded covering category on the lifted projective vertices (grading0). For a lifted object X̃ = (X, h) and a finite set T of lifted projective vertices, V_X̃ restricted to T is a module over the covering algebra cov T (VM): its value at z = (p, g) is the degree g⁻¹h part of C(P_p, X), and L acts by composition. When T contains the support of V_X̃ it is finite-dimensional and indecomposable: "Height gives End(V_X̃) = k, so the modules are indecomposable" (VM_isFiniteIndecomposable, via Lemma 4.8).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
